Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on an untagged COSE_Sign structure with attached payload and two signers (two COSE_Signature elements), each of them counter-signed by one counter signature. Each COSE_Signature (signer layer) shall contain the minimum mandatory components: the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain. The uHeaders unprotected header parameter of each COSE_Signature shall contain exactly one element: the counter signature of that COSE_Signature. The counter signature shall be a full (non abbreviated) version 2 counter signature as specified in IETF RFC 9338 (COSE_Countersignature, label 11), untagged, incorporated as an element of the uHeaders unprotected header parameter of the counter-signed signature (clause 5.1.6). The counter signature shall itself contain at least the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain (identifying the counter-signer certificate) and shall not contain the content type header parameter, as its payload is a signature (clause 5.1.3). Its signature value shall be computed as specified in clause 3.3 of IETF RFC 9338, with context string "CounterSignature". The counter-signed structure in the Countersign_structure shall include the body-layer and signer-layer protected headers of the counter-signed COSE_Signature. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
